design.streamFormula: key=2026120400+1000*state+10*repeat; teacher rng(key+1); student rng(key+2); student cue-period rng(key+3)
design.bitDecoder: one global nearest Euclidean centroid on raw two-DN 240-280 ms spike counts; pooled calibration repeats 0-5; held-out repeats 6-11, six/bit/cue
design.cueDecoder: prior fixed reward-free log1p three-MBON centroids; held-out repeats 6-17
design.gates: target +1 mean spike/cue/bit; bit >=10/12/cue; cue >=10/12/cue/bit and drop <=2/12; no weights change
